capabilities.purpose: Find objects connected to a known anchor through governed relationship rules
useWhen: the anchor and bounded relationship pattern are known
doNotUseWhen: recursive traversal or arbitrary query execution is required
capabilities.resultSemantics: Authorized related objects returned by the UDP server-side fixed relationship plan
securityNotes: Gateway mediation and backend authorization are mandatory
No arbitrary query language or network destination input

capabilities.purpose: Read bounded current OUF MCP operational health from authoritative persisted recovery, debt, evidence and security state
useWhen: the user asks whether the MCP layer is healthy or whether OUF itself has unresolved orchestration problems
doNotUseWhen: raw logs, credentials, SQL or protected evidence payloads are requested
capabilities.resultSemantics: Fixed PUBLIC_OPERATIONAL MCP snapshot: module, status, actionRequired, partial, visibilityClass and redacted; no incident references or counters
securityNotes: Authorization, admission, reconciliation and audit remain mandatory
Human-facing access is Gateway-mediated and channel-neutral; the private owner API never exposes the MCP protocol endpoint

capabilities.purpose: Read the current authorized ingestion/source operational state without raw logs
useWhen: the user asks whether ingestion or a source is healthy now
doNotUseWhen: raw telemetry or protected evidence is requested
capabilities.resultSemantics: Bounded current source health and latest run state
securityNotes: Tenant/source scope and redaction are enforced server-side
Gateway mediation is mandatory

capabilities.purpose: Read bounded historical ingestion runs including failures, retries and recovery context
useWhen: the user asks what happened to an ingestion/source in a past time window
doNotUseWhen: an unbounded audit export is requested
capabilities.resultSemantics: Bounded persisted run history for authorized sources
securityNotes: No secrets or raw stack traces
Gateway mediation is mandatory

capabilities.purpose: List authorized persisted operational incidents, including incidents that occurred while the chatbot was offline
useWhen: the user asks which problems are open, recovering or recently resolved
doNotUseWhen: security-sensitive protected evidence is requested without privileged authorization
capabilities.resultSemantics: Bounded cross-producer incident aggregates with lifecycle, severity and safe impact summaries; opt-in snapshot=true or cursor-only yields stable independently authorized owner-vector pages, consultationRecorded=false Publication coverage is opt-in and covers GATEWAY and INGESTION only; historical MCP self incidents are not covered. Read current urgent owner state separately. Publication positions do not prove client delivery, consultation, acknowledgement or resolution.
securityNotes: MCP aggregates only owner-provided governed projections
Unavailable producer evidence yields partial output and is never mapped to no incidents
A cursor is no authority, delivery receipt or operator checkpoint; each page freshly authorizes the root and both owners. Unavailable/redacted/changed snapshot pages fail without advancing.

capabilities.purpose: Explain one authorized operational incident using safe owner-provided classification and evidence references
useWhen: the user asks why a specific incident happened or what action is recommended
doNotUseWhen: no incident reference is known or raw protected evidence is requested
capabilities.resultSemantics: Owner-specific safe explanation with classification, severity, lifecycle, evidence reference and recommended action
securityNotes: The owner rechecks tenant scope and explain authorization
No raw stack traces, tokens or protected evidence payloads

capabilities.purpose: Summarize significant authorized operational events in a bounded time window for chatbot catch-up
useWhen: the user asks what happened while they were away or whether OUF had problems
doNotUseWhen: the user needs protected raw evidence
capabilities.resultSemantics: Safe cross-producer catch-up summary preserving DEGRADED, RECOVERING and partial semantics
securityNotes: Missing producer evidence must never be manufactured as HEALTHY
Producer calls remain independently Authorization- and Gateway-governed

capabilities.purpose: Commit an approved merge through the Trusted Human Surface
useWhen: a verified human is confirming an exact approved merge plan
doNotUseWhen: an AI agent or MCP client is attempting confirmation
capabilities.resultSemantics: Authoritative merge outcome owned by UDP
securityNotes: Never exposed in tools/list

capabilities.purpose: Inspect configured grants, the tenant role catalogue, or active HUMAN-compatible capability descriptors; view CAPABILITIES supports complete role proposals
useWhen: an authorized user requests permission administration
doNotUseWhen: confirming, publishing, changing superadmin association or editing IAM accounts
capabilities.resultSemantics: Configured grants or a bounded proposal receipt with trusted human review path; never an approval
securityNotes: Gateway verifies workload and delegation; owner reevaluates current policy
Confirmation is only on the direct authenticated THS; no human bearer is forwarded by MCP

capabilities.purpose: Prepare a grant change or a complete replacement of the tenant OUF role catalogue for human THS review; read view ROLES first and preserve unrelated entries. Never publishes permissions.

capabilities.purpose: Adopt the selected discovery candidate as one semantic DRAFT
useWhen: a human has selected a candidate from a successful discovery request
doNotUseWhen: approving or publishing a revision: use the Trusted Human Surface (THS)
capabilities.resultSemantics: The historical owner receipt includes provenance, revisionId and expectedRowVersion for validation with semantic.review.prepare.
securityNotes: HUMAN with current discovery grant and signed delegation required
Keep commandKey stable. After an uncertain outcome use semantic.proposal.read with the original commandKey and current read and adoption grants.

capabilities.purpose: Create one native semantic DRAFT or bounded Turtle ontology DRAFT with a durable caller-scoped receipt
useWhen: preparing authorized native semantic proposals for human review

Choose base types from the controlled vocabulary. If no published type fits structured data, propose a DATATYPE combining base types or pinned published DATATYPEs. Use it only after a human approves it in the THS and the Semantic Registry publishes it

Propose a VALUE_MAP for a column of codes from a controlled vocabulary. Build entries from the column's distinctValues list in the source.file.profile result. If profiling returns a job receipt, read the completed profile with source.file.preview. Preserve the codes and their case, and name the column in rationale.sourceColumn. If distinctValues is absent or the profile only reports a count, tell the user that the column is unsuitable for an agent-built VALUE_MAP

Use semantic.search and semantic.get to identify published concepts in one active published vocabulary and pin that vocabulary as semanticId@publicationSetId. Use only verified concepts from that vocabulary and never invent concepts. After human approval in the THS and publication, use transform: VALUE_MAP_V1 with the published pin in transformParams.valueMapRef
doNotUseWhen: approving, publishing, activating, adopting external terms or bypassing owner decisions
capabilities.resultSemantics: Owner receipt only; a review reference is not human approval or publication. Read current challenge in the THS before decision.
securityNotes: Current owner authorization and Gateway signed delegation are required
Stable commandKey is mandatory for mutation; ambiguous effects require receipt reconciliation
Owner and authority references are proposal values, not grants
Turtle content is bounded input, never a network fetch; imports remain DRAFT until trusted human review

datatypeComponents.description: Use unique component names. The Semantic Registry resolves published pins and checks cycles, depth (4) and total leaf components (256).

entries.description: Codes must be unique and are case sensitive. Concepts may repeat.

capabilities.purpose: Validate the exact DRAFT row version and retain errors and warnings
useWhen: preparing authorized native semantic proposals for human review
doNotUseWhen: approving, publishing, activating, adopting external terms or bypassing owner decisions
capabilities.resultSemantics: Owner receipt only; a review reference is not human approval or publication. Read current challenge in the THS before decision.

capabilities.purpose: Search urban objects of one exact canonical type with bounded owner-authorized pagination
useWhen: the exact object type is known and a bounded object search is needed
doNotUseWhen: relationship traversal, arbitrary predicates or an unbounded query is needed
capabilities.resultSemantics: Only UDP-authorized objects and properties, with an opaque cursor or a partial result when applicable
securityNotes: Gateway workload identity and signed HUMAN delegation are mandatory
UDP checks the owner authorization bundle per object and property
No arbitrary predicates or backend selection

capabilities.purpose: Stage an authenticated user's CSV through the governed Gateway
useWhen: the authenticated human wants to choose a local CSV through the first-party picker, or a supported host supplies a governed file parameter
doNotUseWhen: the requested upload mode is not configured
preferredAlternatives: request the user to choose a CSV from the first-party OUF picker
capabilities.resultSemantics: An idempotent staged asset identity; profiling and DRAFT creation are separate actions
securityNotes: The host URL stays in private request memory and never enters the Gateway envelope
Gateway checks delegated HUMAN scope; Onboarding verifies streamed bytes and owner receipt

capabilities.purpose: Queue profiling of a managed file owned by the authenticated human
useWhen: the user uploaded a CSV through the governed HUMAN attachment flow and knows its asset ID

Build VALUE_MAP entries from the column's distinctValues list in the completed profile. Use source.file.preview to read the result when this tool returns a job receipt. If distinctValues is absent or the profile only reports a count, tell the user that the column is unsuitable for an agent-built VALUE_MAP
doNotUseWhen: the user has no asset ID or wants to read a different user’s file
preferredAlternatives: upload via the governed Agent Host attachment bridge
capabilities.resultSemantics: An idempotent profile job receipt or owner profile result, with distinctValues when available under the same authorization, access labels and redaction as source.file.preview
securityNotes: HUMAN delegation and exact asset ownership are checked by Gateway and Onboarding
No file bytes, base64, filesystem paths or user-chosen URLs in tool arguments

capabilities.purpose: Read an owned profile/job or bounded immutable schema pages (up to 1024 columns)
useWhen: the user needs an owned asset profile/job or must recover uploaded CSV work in a new conversation
Read a completed source.file.profile job for its distinctValues where the owner makes them available. Use that list when proposing a VALUE_MAP and record the column in rationale.sourceColumn
doNotUseWhen: access to another tenant or subject, raw file bytes or storage locations is requested
preferredAlternatives: upload via the governed Agent Host attachment bridge
capabilities.resultSemantics: Redacted preview, bounded profile-job state, or tenant-and-subject-owned asset page with an opaque cursor; ownership is rechecked by Onboarding; COLUMNS view returns immutable schema pages without sample values; follow nextOffset until hasMore=false, preserving profile/version/schemaHash
securityNotes: HUMAN delegation and exact asset ownership are checked by Gateway and Onboarding
No file bytes, base64, filesystem paths or user-chosen URLs in tool arguments

capabilities.purpose: Create an idempotent INTERNAL_MANAGED onboarding DRAFT from a reviewed file profile and pinned semantic references
useWhen: the user has reviewed the owned asset profile and selected pinned semantic references and field access decisions

Choose a reader for each base type from the controlled vocabulary. Combine latitude and longitude with POINT_FROM_LAT_LON_V1. If no published structured type fits, use semantic.propose to combine base types or pinned published types into a DATATYPE. Use it only after human approval in the THS and publication
For a column of codes mapped to a controlled vocabulary, set transform: VALUE_MAP_V1 and put the published semanticId@publicationSetId in transformParams.valueMapRef
doNotUseWhen: the user has no governed asset and profile IDs, or requests approval or activation
preferredAlternatives: profile and preview the owned asset first
trusted HUMAN approval after a validated draft
capabilities.resultSemantics: Bounded DRAFT version identity and state; no approval or ACTIVE configuration
securityNotes: HUMAN delegation, exact asset ownership and retry key are enforced by Gateway and Onboarding
No file bytes, base64, arbitrary URLs or user-chosen storage references

compositions.description: Use INCLUDE fields from this file. Build MANY with ordered items or LIST_SPLIT_V1. Onboarding checks component cardinality, output types and the limit of 256 leaves. New preparations require ACTIVE DATATYPE pins at every level. Published bundles may resolve ACTIVE, DEPRECATED or RETIRED pins. Concept membership requires a pinned CONCEPT of the vocabulary or a pinned value map targeting it.

capabilities.purpose: Search current published semantic artifacts for assisted source mapping

doNotUseWhen: publication, approval or arbitrary external query execution is requested
capabilities.resultSemantics: Owner metadata with exact revision/publication pins; no adoption or lifecycle mutation; dependency truncation is explicit
securityNotes: Gateway workload and signed delegation required
Owner revalidates purpose-bound receipt and current authorization policy
No latest revision fallback; historical reads never approve new mappings

capabilities.resultSemantics: Bounded version state, configuration hash and owner-issued review link; never human approval or source activation
securityNotes: Gateway signed HUMAN delegation and owner source access are checked
Keep the commandKey across interruptions and reconcile current owner state before retrying
No file bytes, arbitrary URLs, grants or caller-issued approval fields

executionProposal.description: Preparation only. CSV cells remain lexical in RAW; explicitly configured string, decimal and date mappings determine materialization types. Owner checks property/access/source/tenant and exact semantic references. No approval, publication, compatibility attestation or runtime authority is issued.

capabilities.purpose: Prepare a revision of an ACTIVE source for native human review
useWhen: the user wants to revise property policies on the current file using changes
the user wants to revise compositions on the active file

the user wants to replace the CSV of the same active source using assetRef. Supply the already uploaded managed asset and its immutable profile. Read the active parent first for its configurationHash and lockVersion

Each new CSV column requires an explicit user decision in newColumns. Use EXCLUDE to leave it out of the projection or MAP with its mapping. If the owner reports NEW_COLUMN_DECISION_REQUIRED, present every named column to the user and ask how to handle each one

Choose readers from the controlled vocabulary. Combine latitude and longitude with POINT_FROM_LAT_LON_V1. If no published structured type fits, propose a DATATYPE combining base types or pinned published types. Use it only after human approval in the THS and publication
For a column of codes mapped to a controlled vocabulary, set transform: VALUE_MAP_V1 and put the published semanticId@publicationSetId in transformParams.valueMapRef
doNotUseWhen: the file belongs to a new source. Use source.onboarding.create
human approval, activation, arbitrary configuration replacement or historical replay is requested
preferredAlternatives: source.onboarding.revision.read with the original sourceId, parentVersionId and commandKey after HTTP 503 or a lost response. Retain the original commandKey even if the owner reports ABSENT
capabilities.resultSemantics: File replacement returns a native review receipt with assetRef, the recorded newColumns decisions in order and empty diagnostics. ONB_REVISION_CSV_INCOMPATIBLE lists the differences by column. The parent stays active during review. Subsequent HUMAN activation can start acquisition.
securityNotes: Exact source/version authorization and existing managed-file ownership remain enforced
Keep the same commandKey after interruptions; changed intent is a new governed revision
The native HUMAN review discloses publication effects; no approval or activation is delegated
